data.name: Anandini
data.long_meaning: Anandini is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ananda’ meaning ‘joy, happiness, or bliss’. The feminine suffix ‘ini’ denotes a woman or a goddess. In Hindu mythology, Anandini is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing joy, prosperity, and abundance.
